## Current signals

- WebNR remains a local-first browser reader and may be described as an independent browser-based alternative for some Legado users and web-first reading workflows. It is unaffiliated with Legado and is not an official Legado web client. Arbitrary Legado source JSON is not yet a drop-in WebNR runtime; compatibility claims remain tied to tested capability levels and versioned fixtures.
- Pull request #133 publishes `没有目录的 TXT 小说合集怎么导入 WebNR？文件夹、编码、来源与自建 Source 实战` and adds `GITenberg Direct TXT Starter`. The source exposes *Pride and Prejudice*, *Frankenstein*, and *The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes* as real direct text imports using immutable upstream GITenberg commits. WebNR stores only its bounded catalog/provenance and performs no background polling, collection crawl, server-side proxying, credential/cookie use, or account automation.
- GITenberg is no longer in the deferred queue at this bounded capability level. It was previously deferred because a second discovery-only Project Gutenberg directory duplicated reader value; the admitted direct-TXT transport is a distinct tested capability and does not imply that the entire GITenberg corpus is automatically safe or supported.
- Project Ben-Yehuda Public Domain TXT Starter remains a bounded four-entry direct UTF-8 source pinned to audited upstream public-domain dump commit `5e4277fead7b565f32cc4b352abd3565023a77d8`. It is not widened to the full dump without catalog identity, update/deletion, request/resource, attribution, fixture, and rollback semantics.
- The 2026-09-01 source program screened OpenITI, Folger Shakespeare Digital Texts, CELT, Perseus canonical Greek/Latin corpora, and EEBO-TCP Phase I. OpenITI and Folger require persistent attribution/noncommercial license handling; CELT's first-party use boundary favors private/teaching/research use over rehosting; Perseus and EEBO-TCP are primarily TEI/XML and require deterministic transformations, item/version identity, rights handling, and fixtures before richer WebNR adapters.
- Pull request #126 remains the versioned Legado baseline: fixture suite `2026-08-30.1` and the local-only inspector implement L1 import/inspection. L2 declarative, L3 stateful, L4 script, and L5 Bridge/WebView requirements may be recognized but are not executed. Inspection is bounded to 2 MiB and 500 source definitions and performs no target-site request, login, Cookie, JavaScript, WebView, CAPTCHA, paywall, robots, DRM, or access-control bypass.
- Pull request #127 remains the documentation analytics repair baseline. Reader and documentation output use only `G-DGH8HNQKE4`, require `page_location: window.location.href` and query-bearing `page_path: window.location.pathname + window.location.search`, and keep `allow_google_signals` plus `allow_ad_personalization_signals` false.
- `https://www.webnovel.win/` is the sole canonical public identity for documentation, reader-facing articles, search indexing, canonical tags, sitemap, and RSS. `https://app.webnovel.win/` is the reader application runtime; `https://autoarchive.github.io/webNR/` is an attributable documentation build mirror only.
- `Fanfiction Discovery Starter` remains at eight audited first-party discovery destinations: FanFiction.Net, Fimfiction, Scribble Hub, Archive of Our Own (AO3), SquidgeWorld, fanfiction.lol, Sunset, and Asianfanfics. Its current capability remains bounded discovery links plus WebNR-authored metadata; link-only is a proven current level, not a permanent policy ceiling.
- AO3 remains admitted for first-party Work Search discovery. Canonical-tag Atom remains a richer machine-interface candidate requiring runtime transport, stable identity, update semantics, cadence/response bounds, attribution, and versioned fixtures before synchronization is claimed.
- Fimfiction remains the strongest official-API upgrade candidate technically, but the current first-party developer/application-management path requires an externally created API application/client identity. WebNR must not fabricate credentials. Once that prerequisite exists, the adapter still requires bounded OAuth transport, rate-limit/backoff, caching, stable identity, cursor pagination, response/timeout bounds, provenance, attribution, update/deletion semantics, and fixtures.
- The currently accepted maintained source set is: WebNR Originals, Aozora Bunko Starter, Standard Ebooks Starter, Project Madurai Starter, English Serial Platforms Starter, Project Gutenberg Starter, Global Grey Starter, Online Books Page Starter, Wolne Lektury Starter, Wikisource Starter, English Web-Fiction Discovery Starter, Chinese Web-Fiction Platforms Starter, Japanese Web-Fiction Platforms Starter, Korean Web-Fiction Platforms Starter, Progression & LitRPG Publisher Discovery Starter, Fanfiction Discovery Starter, Web Novel Discussion Radar Starter, Classics & Open Reading Discovery Starter, Project Ben-Yehuda Public Domain TXT Starter, and GITenberg Direct TXT Starter. Rights/access and runtime behavior remain source-specific.
